Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, proteinuria, nitrites, hematuria, and bacteriuria, with >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli cultured, indicating a urinary tract infection. The low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. No casts were seen. Findings are consistent with an active bacterial UTI; clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy are recommended.
